name: DatePicker
summary: Read-only field-shell trigger with leading calendar glyph; click opens a portaled calendar popover. v0.7 ships the visual contract; consumers compose react-day-picker for real selection logic.

onChange.description: Fires with an ISO date string when a day is picked.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag for formatting (defaults to navigator.language).

keyboard: Space / Enter on trigger — open the calendar
Home / End — start / end of week
rules: Trigger is a real <button> or labeled read-only <input> — never a <div>.
Calendar lives in a portal so it escapes overflow:hidden ancestors.
Today is marked by border, not fill — so it doesn't compete with selection.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion — open/close collapses to instant.
Always paired with a visible label via Field, or with aria-label.

do: Compose react-day-picker for real selection, locale, and range-picker logic. Lumen defines the shell only.
Format the displayed date per the user's locale via Intl.DateTimeFormat.
Default the calendar to the selected month, or to today if no selection.
Use the audit-dashboard's DatePickerCalendar as a visual starting point.
dont: Don't ship the v0.7 static scaffold to production — it has no real selection logic.
Don't lock the user into the calendar — let them paste or type a date if your consumer adds that capability.
Don't use lime fill for 'today' — it competes with selection. Use border-only.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitives (DatePicker + DatePickerCalendar) to a dedicated contract. Visual shell + scaffold calendar; real selection logic deferred to v0.8 react-day-picker integration.
